WoW: Forever

Arcane Mage

Burst damage on a mana curve you have to manage. Arcane is genuinely new in Forever: Arcane BlastArcane BlastSpell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRangeMeleeBlasts an enemy with Arcane magic, inflicting normal damage plus 10 and knocking the enemy back. is a new spell, Missile BarrageMissile BarrageTalentCastInstantGives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec. a new talent, and Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. went from Classic's 15% to 50% mana regeneration while casting.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Arcane build has been tested. No source has posted a level 30 build either: the cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three has published one since. The level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs. No guide has recommended it.

What Arcane is for

Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. 3/3 keeps 50% of your regeneration running through every cast. That is what pays for Arcane BlastArcane BlastSpell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRangeMeleeBlasts an enemy with Arcane magic, inflicting normal damage plus 10 and knocking the enemy back., whose mana cost climbs +175% per cast.

Icy Veins rates it 4/5 for levelling; Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish no levelling score. Its heading is "A Solid Leveling Spec": "Arcane Mages in Forever level up very well… The Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. talent significantly reduces downtime between fights… and Missile BarrageMissile BarrageTalentCastInstantGives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec. reduces the mana cost of Arcane Missiles by 100%."

In Classic, Arcane Power raid builds spent their damage casts on Frostbolt instead of the Arcane tree's own spells; ClassicWoW.gg puts it plainly: "Forever gives you Arcane Blast and Missile Barrage to build around Arcane-school damage itself."

The dungeon caveat: "if the tank is not good enough, you will pull aggro… the Arcane Mage cannot slow enemies as effectively as a Frost Mage (but still sufficient)."

Solo and dungeon builds exist at both 20 and 30, and they differ a lot.

A third published build opens Wand SpecializationWand SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases your damage with Wands by 13%. 2 → Arcane FocusArcane FocusTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%. 3 → Arcane SubtletyArcane SubtletyTalentCastInstantReduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%. 2 → Arcane ConcentrationArcane ConcentrationTalentCastInstant 3 → Arcane BlastArcane BlastSpell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRangeMeleeBlasts an enemy with Arcane magic, inflicting normal damage plus 10 and knocking the enemy back.. It takes Arcane SubtletyArcane SubtletyTalentCastInstantReduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%. for its 15 spell resistance reduction rather than its threat cut. It names the flex point itself: "the other 3 points either, to your preference, in Arcane FocusArcane FocusTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%. or Arcane ChannelingArcane ChannelingTalentCastInstantDurationUntil cancelled" [no talent has that name; they mean Improved ChannelingImproved ChannelingTalentCastInstantGives you a 20% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 14% chance while casting Arcane Blast.].

Blizzard has since moved Arcane SubtletyArcane SubtletyTalentCastInstantReduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%. from row 1 to row 2, so it needs 5 points in the tree first and can no longer open a build. The same change made its resistance effect stronger and its threat cut weaker. The client reads 15 resistance and a 30% threat cut, so that 15 is current, not the old figure.

Stat priority

Icy Veins is the only one of the three tracked sources that ranks Arcane's stats; its order:

  1. Hit — "your best stat until the cap", though low-level gear rarely carries much of it
  2. Spell Power (Arcane) — "the most sought-after stat"
  3. Spirit — ranked above Intellect on purpose: "Spirit is a powerhouse… works while you cast, especially with Mage ArmorMage ArmorLevel 34 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost270 ManaDuration1800 secIncreases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec. and Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting."
  4. Intellect — a bigger mana pool and a small crit bonus
  5. Critical strike — take it when it's on gear, but "only gets really powerful when you have 5 talent points in Arcane MindArcane MindTalentCastInstantIncreases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%."
  6. Stamina — comes along for free on most gear
  7. MP5 — lowest priority; usually a healer stat

What Forever changed for Arcane

  • Arcane MindArcane MindTalentCastInstantIncreases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%. was rewritten: now +10% Intellect at 5/5 and +100% Arcane critical damage, where Classic gave flat maximum mana.
  • Arcane ImpactArcane ImpactTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%. (renamed from Improved Arcane Explosion) now buffs all Arcane spells' crit. Improved ChannelingImproved ChannelingTalentCastInstantGives you a 20% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 14% chance while casting Arcane Blast. (renamed from Improved Arcane Missiles) now protects Arcane BlastArcane BlastSpell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRangeMeleeBlasts an enemy with Arcane magic, inflicting normal damage plus 10 and knocking the enemy back. too, 70% at 5/5 — a total scaled up from the client's single-rank figure, so ours, not a source's.
  • Arcane ConcentrationArcane ConcentrationTalentCastInstant procs less from low-rank casts. Blizzard blames gold farmers fishing for procs with cheap ranks, and says to expect the same penalty on "any similar talents that trigger a free effect". Cast near your trained rank.
  • Arcane GeometryArcane GeometryTalentCastInstantIncreases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards. is a new row 3 talent and extends the range of your Arcane spells. Arcane ShieldingArcane ShieldingTalentCastInstantDecreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%. (formerly Improved Mana Shield) now adds resistances to Mage ArmorMage ArmorLevel 34 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost270 ManaDuration1800 secIncreases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec. as well.
  • Arcane FocusArcane FocusTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%. was rewritten from resistance reduction to plain Arcane hit. Wand SpecializationWand SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases your damage with Wands by 13%. and Arcane ResilienceArcane ResilienceTalentCastInstantIncreases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect. now cost 2 points for their full effect; the tier 1 placement of Wand SpecializationWand SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases your damage with Wands by 13%. is the client's, not Blizzard's. Arcane ResilienceArcane ResilienceTalentCastInstantIncreases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect. is row 2 and no longer a gold medal, and Magic AttunementMagic AttunementTalent · Rank 2CastInstantIncreases the effect of your Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic spells by 50%. is baseline. Magic AbsorptionMagic AbsorptionTalentCastInstantIncreases all your resistances by 2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec. triggers at most once a second, and its drop to 2 ranks is the published builds' count rather than Blizzard's or the client's. Improved CounterspellImproved CounterspellLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantYour Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec. no longer rolls a chance: rank 1 always silences for 2 seconds and rank 2 for 4, where Classic gave a 50% chance at rank 1. At 2/2 it is unchanged.
  • Arcane ExplosionArcane ExplosionSpell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost330 ManaSends out a blast wave of magic, inflicting 192 Arcane damage to nearby enemies. was barely touched: rank 6 is 232–252, against Classic's 243–263.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
